proposition: The Kārkiyā addressed in the exile letters are Sayyid Aḥmad (Ranikuh) and Sayyid Nāṣir (Lahijan), not Sayyid Riżā Kārkiyā, who died in 829/1426 before Ibn Turka's stay; the other-MS letters labelled as from and to Riżā Kiyā are therefore misidentified, and the initial letter from the amir to Ibn Turka survives only there.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: MK's inference from Riżā Kārkiyā's death date
